|ingredients = {{Name|Tuna|1}}{{Name|Tortilla|1}}{{Name|Red Cabbage|1}}{{Name|Mayonnaise|1}} }} '''Fish Taco''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (7% chance). It can randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]] for {{Price|50}}–{{Price|500}}, in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock for {{Price|1000}}, or at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|500}}. It can also randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s outside the saloon. One Fish Taco may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Fish Taco per year on [[Caroline]]'s birthday, [[Winter|Winter 7]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy |love=Caroline,Gus |hate=Emily |dislike=Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Fish Taco is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Fish Taco is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Party Hat (green)|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Fish Taco is not used in any [[quests]]. ==References== See FishingRod::openTreasureMenuEndFunction in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Can now be prepared using a [[Cookout Kit]].}} {{History|1.6|Can now be obtained from [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]].}} {{NavboxRecipes}} [[Category:Recipes]] [[Category:Cooking]] [[de:Fisch-Taco]] [[es:Taco de pescado]] [[fr:Tacos de poisson]] [[it:Taco di pesce]] [[ja:フィッシュタコス]] [[ko:생선 타코]] [[hu:Hal taco]] [[pt:Taco de peixe]] [[ru:Рыбные тако]] [[tr:Balıklı Tako]] [[zh:鱼肉卷]]
